episodes.154783: A strong upper shortwave, with very cold temperatures aloft, contributed to some showers producing small hail.
episodes.155114: Isolated gale-force wind gusts occurred in association with a thunderstorm over Ramrod Key as a stationary front was located just to the north, over south Florida and the southeast Gulf of Mexico.  A weak wave of low pressure moving eastward along the front helped enhance convergence and thunderstorm coverage over the Florida Keys.
